entries.q_thai: บัตรเอทีเอ็มใช้ทำอะไรคะ

entries.a_spanish: Sirve para sacar dinero del cajero.
entries.a_en: It's used to withdraw money from the ATM.

entries.a_phonetic: bát khray-dìt chái ngěn tha-naa-khaan khâ

entries.a_spanish: La tarjeta de crédito usa dinero del banco.
entries.a_en: Credit card uses the bank's money.

entries.q_thai: บัตรประกันใช้ทำอะไรคะ

entries.a_spanish: Se usa cuando estás enfermo o tienes un accidente.
entries.a_en: It's used when you're sick or have an accident.

entries.a_spanish: Hay que denunciarlo en la comisaría.
entries.a_en: You must report it at the police station.

entries.q_spanish: Se tramita en la oficina del distrito.

entries.a_phonetic: pai tham thîi thîi-wâa-gaan amp-hǔea khâ

entries.a_en: It's done at the district office.
